name: model-capability-assessment
description: Assess a foundation model's agent capabilities from public benchmarks, Snorkel SDS results, and user feedback; produce internal and client-facing reports.

interface.shortDescription: Agent capability gaps for any model, internal and client-facing
interface.longDescription: Place a model on a fixed agent-capability taxonomy using public benchmark results, Snorkel SDS frontier results, and English and Chinese user feedback, then write gap recommendations as an internal artifact and a bilingual client-facing report.
